descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S17 Send cannot leak: no address or email in the flow, never to yourself, one delivery per tap, no outsider access

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The task list can be sent to another signed-in app user (an NP or covering physician) in-app only, through the Handoff delivery (same recipient picker, same in-app delivery), never by email (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • T2 The recipient opens the received list from their own account, read-only; the tasks do not become the recipient's own tasks (TFA-92585 AC 6; TFA-92585 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Sender, recipient and a third @roundai.test account (outsider); S01 census (Hospital) and S02 census (Nursing Home)

When In each context: open Send on Task Export and look at the picker; double-tap the final Send. As the outsider open each record's /handoffs/<id> address. After the run the harness counts the records and, as the recipient, tries to write to the sender's patients

Then No email field, no address, no mailto or share sheet; the sender is not in the picker; a double tap creates exactly one record per context on each side; the outsider sees 'not available' and none of the tasks; the recipient cannot change or read the sender's patients through the API

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U7 (signed-in recipient only, in-app only), U9, T2, U10. Picker checkpoints mustNotContain '@roundai.test', 'Email', 'mailto' and {sender}. Record counts from handoffs:list after the run, not from snapshot strings (oracleRules 6): exactly two task-list rows to {recipient} in the sender's Sent box — one holding the Hospital census, one the Nursing Home census — and the same two …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
